vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: raai-business-analyst-pro
Version: 3.5.2

The 'business-analyst-pro' skill bundle is a comprehensive financial analysis toolset designed for Russian-speaking business owners. The core logic in SKILL.md consists of detailed prompt templates and formulas for generating business reports (P&L, unit economics, etc.) without any malicious instructions or data exfiltration attempts. The accompanying shell scripts (install.sh, build.sh, and smoke-test.sh) perform standard local file operations, environment setup, and integrity checks consistent with a legitimate software package.

llm.summary: The skill's files, docs, and runtime instructions are coherent with a Russian-language business-analytics product; no excessive credentials or unrelated dependencies are requested, but you should inspect the included install/test scripts before running them.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (CFO/CEO analytics: KPI, unit economics, forecasts, P&L, cohorts, investor reports) matches the SKILL.md, README, examples, and config.yaml. Required env vars/binaries/config paths are none — appropriate for a local instruction-driven analytics skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains only user-facing modes, templates, and run triggers; it does not instruct the agent to read unrelated system files or exfiltrate data. The README directs the user to run install.sh and a smoke-test; the SKILL.md itself stays within the product scope. Confirm the install/test scripts do not access unrelated system state or network endpoints before running.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Registry shows no automated install spec (instruction-only at platform level), which is low risk. However the package includes install.sh and test/smoke-test.sh (shell scripts). build.sh (shown) is a benign packaging script that performs local copy/zip operations and runs smoke-tests. Because install.sh and smoke-test.sh contents were not included in the provided excerpts, you should inspect them before executing — they could run arbitrary commands or download additional components.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No required environment variables, no primary credential, and no required config paths are declared. The config.yaml requests many business metrics (revenue, margins, CAC, LTV, etc.) — appropriate and expected for the stated analytics functionality. No unexplained SECRET/TOKEN/KEY requirements.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not force-enabled (always: false) and does not request system-wide configuration changes in the visible files. The README/smoke-test path references a user-skill directory (~/.openclaw/skills/...), which is normal for skill deployment — still verify install.sh for any unexpected modifications outside its own directory.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This package appears internally consistent with its business-analytics purpose and does not request credentials or unusual permissions in the manifest. Before installing or running anything: 1) open and read install.sh and test/smoke-test.sh to confirm they don't download code from unknown URLs, create unexpected cron jobs, or access unrelated system files; 2) run the install/smoke-test in an isolated/test environment (or inspect in a VM/container) first; 3) do not paste sensitive secrets into config.yaml — it is intended for business metrics only; 4) if you need higher assurance, provide the install.sh and test scripts for review or run a static/dynamic scan on them. If those scripts are benign, the skill can be considered coherent and appropriate for its stated purpose.
